snippet.title: Neat Games Devlog #21 - STEAM Trailer Super Neat Cat - First edit and more!
snippet.description:
►►►Please WISHLIST my game on STEAM: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2248230/YesterSol/ 
👇 Show more for neat info.👇
►►►Discord: https://discord.com/invite/S4qHyuK

📖 About YesterSol 📖
Unleash your magical spear! Explore a vast inter-connected world, battling enemies sent by Culex, the dark mosquito deity. Throw, recall, and use your spear as a platform through this minimalistic metroidvania made by one developer!

👨‍🏫 About Me 🤓
Hello there! I'm an American who has spent more than a decade teaching English in Korea (and never leaving, hehe). During the pandemic, I stumbled upon the fascinating world of game development, and it swiftly evolved into my greatest passion. Exploring various game concepts, from farming sims to 3D Zelda-like adventures, I eventually discovered that crafting a Metroidvania is where my heart and skills match perfectly. For the past year, I've been immersed in the creation of YesterSol, pouring my creativity and dedication into this evolving project.

🐈 My first Steam game - Super Neat Cat🐈
Play for FREE here:  https://store.steampowered.com/app/1452770/Super_Neat_Cat/

►►►Socials: https://linktr.ee/NeatGames

► I was inspired to make devlogs and games from these awesome YouTubers:  Thomas Brush, Blackthornprod, Jonas Tyroller, Brackeys, gamesplusjames, BenBonk, Devduck, Dani, Gamedev Underground, Pontypants, and many more!

► Specs and Programs: I make games in Unity and do the art in Photoshop.  Most of my sounds are from freesound.org and I tweak them in Audacity.  In game music is all from a 500 song music pack I got on the unity asset store.  I use a pretty standard desktop with and i7, 16gb ram, nividia gtx something.  My wife or I edit videos in the free version of Davinci.
